text: Exciting news! Dr. N. Rahimi is joining Fernleaf Family Practice near Eglinton and Warden next month and will be accepting new patients of all ages. Dr. Rahimi sees patients in English, Farsi and Dari. Call the front desk at 416-555-0145 to get on the list. Please share with anyone who still needs a family doctor!

Posted 2026-10-28. Marigold Community Health in Parkdale has a new nurse practitioner, Ana Reyes, NP, who is taking new patients starting this week. Appointments in English, Tagalog and Spanish. Phone 416-555-0172. Bring your health card if you have one.

Newsletter, November 3, 2026: Cedar Gate Medical in Agincourt reminds patients that flu shots are available on Saturdays. We hope to welcome a second physician in the new year. Services in Mandarin, Cantonese and English.
